summary: Backend-only verification of two fixes: (1) deep_dive.py defensive numeric coercion against non-numeric factor values, (2) parlay_optimizer.is_eligible_leg() alt-prop carve-out. 17/17 tests pass. /api/version returns data_version='2026.06.23-alt-parlay-eligible'. /api/picks/parlay?legs=5&window_hours=24 returned 4 legs with 2 Tennis ALT legs (Dalma Galfi Over 16.0, Leylah Fernandez Over 16.5). Standalone is_eligible_leg unit tests confirm: alt pick {lock=95, edge=2.0, wp=80} → True in standard mode; same pick without is_alt → False with 'edge +2.0% < +3%'. compute_confidence_score / compute_edge_score / compute_risk_score now handle string and None factor values without crashing. No 'deep_dive failed: unsupported operand' warnings observed in the last 10 minutes of backend.err.log. Regression: /api/picks/today returns 299 picks; /api/picks/today?sport=Tennis&market=tennis_alt returns 30+ picks; /api/picks/{id}/pitcher-h2h returns 200 for MLB pitcher picks.

minor.issue: The `sport` query-param does NOT strictly restrict the returned legs — a Tennis-filtered request returned a Soccer leg (Ilves Tampere vs KuPS Kuopio). Pre-existing, NOT part of this fix. Worth a separate investigation.

record_parlay_shown fails with E11000 duplicate key error (id_1 dup key: { id: null }) on EVERY parlay request. Pre-existing — parlay records being inserted with id=null. Visible flood in backend.err.log. Suggest setting a UUID id or removing the index.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why /api/picks/parlay?sport=Tennis returns Soccer legs — pre-existing, NOT this fix's scope.
(Optional) Fix the parlay_history E11000 duplicate-key flood by generating an id (UUID) before inserting or dropping the unique id index.
Main agent can self-test deep_dive + alt parlay behavior — both verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: deep_dive.py — try/except float() coercion applied in compute_edge_score, compute_confidence_score, compute_risk_score (and inside the factors loop). Clean and minimal. ✅
parlay_optimizer.is_eligible_leg() — alt-prop carve-out only lowers min_edge to 1.0% if it was higher; lock_score and win_probability gates remain unchanged. Safe. ✅
DATA_VERSION bumped to '2026.06.23-alt-parlay-eligible' — phones will wipe local pick cache as intended. ✅

Sport filter on parlay endpoint isn't strict (returns mixed sports). Both are out of scope for the 2026.06.23 fix. 17/17 alt-parlay + deep-dive regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_alt_parlay_deep_dive_fix.py.
rca_of_issue: Original deep_dive crash: scrapers (tennis_extra, soccer pipeline) populate `factors` with string descriptions (e.g., 'strong recent run' instead of a 0–100 score), so `sum(factors.values())` raised TypeError when the dict mixed ints and strings. Fix wraps each `float(v)` in try/except and skips non-numeric entries. Alt parlay issue: MIN_EDGE_PCT=3.0 (standard mode) excludes chalk-ladder alt-spread picks whose model edge is +1 to +2% by construction. Fix: when `pick.is_alt` or `pick.is_alt_prop` is truthy, drop min_edge to 1.0% only (lock/win_p gates unchanged), so chalkier alt picks make the parlay leg pool without forcing the user into high-risk mode.
